capabilities: Generate flashcards from selected text or an entire note via a configured LLM endpoint
Review due cards in Q&A, cloze, and multiple-choice formats with four FSRS ratings
Cram today's reviewed cards without affecting FSRS scheduling
Search, edit, validate, and delete cards in a card manager
Visualize daily review counts on a 12-month activity heatmap
extras: Review works entirely offline and stores all data in vault plugin data; only card generation sends note text to the configured LLM endpoint. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create flashcards from notes with AI or schedule their review with a spaced repetition algorithm.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (base URL, API key, model)

summary: AI-powered flashcard generator that turns note selections or whole notes into Q&A, cloze and multiple-choice cards, reviewed with an FSRS scheduler.
